## Summary

I added support for the language server to handle files **outside** the configured workspace by promoting the previously test-only `DynamicWithWorkspaces` mode into a real, exported feature. In this mode a fallback "dynamic" worker (rooted at `file:///`) serves any file URI not covered by an explicit workspace worker, so formatting and diagnostics work for parent/sibling files while workspace-scoped files still route to their own worker.

### Changes (source files only)

**`crates/oxc_language_server/src/worker_manager.rs`**
- Removed all `#[cfg(test)]` gating from the `DynamicWithWorkspaces(Box<RwLock<WorkspaceWorker>>)` variant, `WorkerManager::new_with_mode`, and every code path that handles it (`start_manager`, `stop_manager`, `read_dynamic_worker`, `get_worker_for_uri` fallback, and `WorkerGuardInner::Single`). These now compile and run in production.
- Removed the now-unfulfilled `#[expect(dead_code)]` on `RequireWorkspace` (the enum is now public API).
- Added `# Errors`/`# Panics` doc sections that pedantic clippy now requires on the newly-reachable public methods.

**`crates/oxc_language_server/src/lib.rs`**
- Exported `WorkspaceWorker`, `ManagerMode`, and `WorkerManager` from the crate root.
- Updated `run_server` to construct a `WorkerManager` (standard mode) and pass it to `Backend::new`.

**`crates/oxc_language_server/src/backend.rs`**
- Changed `Backend::new`'s third parameter from `Arc<dyn ToolBuilder>` to `WorkerManager`, and dropped the now-unused `ToolBuilder` import.

The existing backend logic already (a) returns a full pull-diagnostic report via `get_worker_for_uri`, and (b) registers file watchers only for explicit workspace workers, never for the dynamic root worker — satisfying those two requirements.

### A deliberate scoping decision
`run_server` uses the **standard** `WorkerManager::new` rather than `DynamicWithWorkspaces`. `run_server` is shared by both `oxlint` and `oxfmt`, and the linter's builder calls `discover_configs_in_tree(root_path, …)` — a dynamic worker rooted at `file:///` would make oxlint recursively scan the entire filesystem. The `DynamicWithWorkspaces` capability is fully implemented and exported for the `Backend` to use; wiring it into a specific production entry point without regressing oxlint would need a per-tool mode selection, which is outside the listed interface changes.
